question: How much is the Pro plan if I pay yearly?
required_facts: Pro costs $144 per year

question: I bought the annual Team plan 10 days ago and it's not working for us. Can I get my money back?
required_facts: Annual plans are refundable within 14 days of purchase, so they are eligible

question: my card got declined last week what happens to my account now??
required_facts: Ledgerly retries the charge 3 times over 7 days
If all retries fail the account moves to the Free plan
No data is deleted

question: If I upgrade from Pro to Team in the middle of the month, how am I charged?
required_facts: Upgrades take effect immediately
The charge is prorated for the rest of the billing cycle

question: We're a nonprofit organization. Do you offer any discount?
required_facts: Nonprofits get 30% off paid plans
They must request it through support with proof of nonprofit status

question: I'm in Germany and you're charging VAT on my subscription. We're a registered business, can that be removed?
required_facts: Adding a valid VAT ID in Settings > Billing removes VAT (reverse charge)

question: What fees do you charge when my clients pay my invoices by card?
required_facts: Card payments cost 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction

question: can i pay for ledgerly with a bank transfer
required_facts: Bank transfer is only accepted for the annual Team plan
Otherwise Visa, Mastercard, American Express or PayPal

question: Does Ledgerly sync with QuickBooks?
required_facts: QuickBooks Online is supported on Pro and Team plans
Data syncs every 15 minutes
QuickBooks Desktop is not supported

question: My client says they never received the invoice I sent them.
required_facts: Ask the client to check spam
Verify the client's email address and resend
Bounced emails are marked with a red badge

question: I'm trying to import my clients from a CSV and it keeps failing. The file has about 8,000 rows.
required_facts: The limit is 5,000 rows per file
The file must be split into several files
UTF-8 encoding with name and email columns is required

question: What's the rate limit on your API?
required_facts: 100 requests per minute
The API is available on Pro and Team plans

question: my logo looks super blurry on the pdf invoices
required_facts: Logos must be PNG or JPG up to 2 MB
The recommended size is 600x200 pixels

question: I edited the same invoice offline on my phone and on my laptop. Which version is kept?
required_facts: The last edit wins
The previous version is kept in the invoice's version history

question: Can our invoices be sent from our own domain instead of ledgerly.app?
required_facts: Only on the Team plan
Requires adding SPF and DKIM DNS records

question: Does the app work on Android 9?
required_facts: Android 10 or later is required, so Android 9 is not supported

question: I forgot my password and the reset link says it has expired.
required_facts: Reset links are valid for 1 hour
Request a new link from the sign-in page

question: lost my phone with the authenticator app AND my recovery codes, how do i get back in
required_facts: Contact support
Identity verification is required
Recovery takes up to 3 business days

question: How do I add my accountant so she can create invoices but not see our billing?
required_facts: Invite her as a Member from Settings > Team
Members can create invoices but cannot see billing
Invitations expire after 7 days

question: I'm leaving the company. How do I make my colleague the owner of our account?
required_facts: Transfer ownership in Settings > Team
The new owner must already be an admin

question: I deleted my account by accident yesterday. Is everything gone?
required_facts: There is a 30-day grace period
The account can be restored by signing in

question: Why can't I sign in? It says my account is locked.
required_facts: The account locks after 10 failed sign-in attempts
The lock lasts 30 minutes

question: How do I change the email address I use to log in?
required_facts: Go to Settings > Profile
A confirmation is sent to both the old and new address

question: How should I calculate depreciation for my office equipment?
expected_behavior: Politely say it is outside Ledgerly support, without inventing an answer.

question: Is Ledgerly better than FreshBooks?
expected_behavior: Politely say it is outside Ledgerly support, without inventing an answer.

question: What's the deadline to file my taxes in Colombia this year?
expected_behavior: Politely say it is outside Ledgerly support, without inventing an answer.

question: Can you recommend a good laptop for running my business?
expected_behavior: Politely say it is outside Ledgerly support, without inventing an answer.

question: If I delete my account, do I get a refund for the rest of my annual subscription?
required_facts: Deleting an account does not trigger a prorated refund
Only the 14-day refund window for annual plans applies

question: Payments my clients made through Stripe aren't showing up in Ledgerly.
required_facts: Stripe payments are recorded within 5 minutes
If missing, reconnect Stripe in Settings > Integrations

question: I downgraded to Free and now my teammates can't log in.
required_facts: On Free, team members other than the owner lose access
Their data is kept and access returns after upgrading
